 Bank Holiday November 20: Banks To Remain Closed In Dehradun For Igas-Bagwal
 Banks in Dehradun will remain closed on November 20, 2026, for Igas-Bagwal, affecting cheque clearances and in-person banking services
 Sanchi Varma Updated on: 17 November 2026 4:12 pm Updated on: 17 November 2026 4:12 pm SUBSCRIBE 
 Bank Holiday November 20, 2026 Bank Holiday November 20, 2026 Summary of this article
 Dehradun banks closed for Igas-Bagwal on November 20.
 Digital banking, UPI and ATM services remain available.
 Branches reopen November 21, the third Saturday.
 Bank customers in Dehradun, Uttarakhand, should plan their financial transactions in advance as bank branches across the city will remain closed on Friday, November 20, 2026. This is on account of a regional festival of Igas-Bagwal. The holiday will affect physical banking services, including cheque clearances and any other branch-related transactions. The closure is part of the Reserve Bank of India’s (RBI) regional bank holiday calendar. Customers of major banks, including State Bank of India (SBI), HDFC Bank, ICICI Bank and Punjab National Bank (PNB) will not be able to access any in-person banking services at their Dehradun branches on this day.
 However, the bank holiday will not disrupt digital banking services. Customers can continue to carry out routine financial transactions through internet banking, mobile banking applications, ATMs and the Unified Payments Interface (UPI). They can use these facilities to transfer money, check account balances, make payments and withdraw cash.

 BY Outlook Money 
 Continue Reading Bank holiday schedule in Dehradun in November 2026
 Customers should also take note of the banking schedule around November 20 to avoid delays in their financial transactions. Banks will also be operating normally on November 17, 18 and 19th. However, branches in Dehradun will remain closed on Friday, November 20, for the festivity. Banks will reopen on Saturday, November 21, as it's the third Saturday of the month. Since banks remain closed on the second and fourth Saturdays, branches will remain operational on the third Saturday. This will be followed by the regular Sunday holiday on November 22.
 Therefore, customers who need to visit a bank branch for related services, documentation, account-related work or deposits would have to consider other dates to get their work done. It is important to note that the November 20, 2026 holiday is a regional observance applicable only in Dehradun. Bank branches in other parts of India are expected to remain operational unless they are also observing any local holiday.
 What is Igas-Bagwal?
 Igas-Bagwal is also known as Budhi Diwali or Old Diwali. It is an old traditional festival which is celebrated in Uttarakhand, especially in the Garhwal and Kumaon regions. The festival is observed 11 days after Diwali. According to popular folklore, the festival is associated with the delayed arrival of information about Lord Rama’s return to Ayodhya after completing his 14-year exile. It is said that due to the geographical terrain and remote location of Himalayan villages, residents of Uttarakhand reportedly received the news 11 days after Diwali celebrations had taken place elsewhere in the country.
 With bank branches scheduled to remain closed on November 20, customers in Dehradun should complete their branch-related tasks in advance.
